subject: POC evaluation plan + prompt/logs request (FinLytics)
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC evaluation plan + prompt/logs request (FinLytics)

Thanks for the call earlier, Alex — great context and appreciate the pacing constraints for your December pilot. Following up with a concise post-call recap, success criteria proposal, and the exact data we need to get the POC running. Please review and confirm the owners/timelines below.

Key goals / success criteria (proposal):
- Latency: end-to-end 95th percentile generation latency < 350ms for single-turn prompt set (~max tokens = 512).
- Quality: match-or-improve on existing A/B baseline for the three critical user flows (invoice parsing, anomaly detection prompts, narrative summarization) measured by our eval metrics (Accuracy, ROUGE-L, and domain-specific rule checks).
- Cost: average inference cost per 1k tokens below your threshold of $0.60 using suggested batching + quantization profile.
- Reliability: no failed requests >0.1% over a 48hr soak on a reserved instance.

POC scope & evaluation plan (high level):
1) Phase 1 (Week 0–2): Prompt and dataset collection + environment setup. We validate data schema and run a dry eval on a small sample (100–500 prompts).
2) Phase 2 (Week 2–4): Full eval runs, quality metrics capture, latency/cost profiling, and a joint review.
3) Phase 3 (Week 4–6): Optimization pass (caching, batching, quantization), second round of metrics, and decision call.

Ownership & next steps:
- FinLytics owner: Alex Gomez (technical contact) — provide prompt samples, representative logs, and expected SLA target for production.
- Redwood owner: Soojin Lee (sales lead) & Rafael Mendes (solutions engineer) — set up the POC infra, run evals, and deliver reports.

Data we need from FinLytics to start Phase 1 (please upload to the secure link below):
- Representative prompt set (CSV): row per prompt, columns: prompt_id, user_text, expected_output_snippet (if available), user_flow_tag. See attached CSV template.
- 1–2 days of anonymized production logs (if possible) with request/response pairs (redact PII). If logs are sensitive, provide a sample or let us arrange a secure transfer.
- Any hard success/fail rules or domain validators you use today (as code snippets or docs).

Proposed timeline: if we get the prompt set + sample logs by Thu 2026-02-12, we can complete Phase 1 validation by 2026-02-19 and schedule the Phase 2 run for the week of 2026-02-23.

Secure upload: https://redwood.example.com/s3-upload/secure/finlytics-20260209 (expires 2026-02-19)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/finlytics

Attachments: redwood_poc_template.xlsx (CSV template + eval metric sheet)

Thanks — looking forward to the sample prompts so Rafael can run the first dry eval.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finlytics.com>

Cc: Priya Nair <priya.nair@finlytics.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC evaluation plan + prompt/logs request (FinLytics)

Thanks, Soojin — that recap looks right. Priya (our technical lead) and I reviewed the success criteria; latency and cost targets look feasible to test. A couple clarifications:

- For "anonymized production logs" — we can export a sample with request/response pairs; will redact user PHI before upload.
- Preferred transfer method: an SFTP or pre-signed S3 link works. Is the link you included a presigned S3 drop or a web upload?
- We have 15k prompts in our test corpus; we will pick ~1k representative prompts for Phase 1 unless you recommend otherwise.

We will attach a small CSV sample by EOD Wednesday. Full set (1k) targeted by Fri 2026-02-12. Can your team sign a simple DPA addendum? Our legal will ping you if needed — happy to start that in parallel.

—
Alex Gomez
Head of Data Products | FinLytics
alex.gomez@finlytics.com | +1 (212) 555-0133

Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC evaluation plan + prompt/logs request (FinLytics)

Appreciate the quick reply, Alex. The upload link is a secure presigned S3 endpoint managed by our intake service (one-time use, TLS). The token expires on 2026-02-19; let us know if you need a longer window. If your security team prefers SFTP/pulled transfer, Rafael can coordinate details.

On DPA: we have a one-page DPA addendum used for POCs — attaching that here as a stub. If your legal wants to route via DocuSign, please share the contact and we'll route accordingly.

Suggested sample size for Phase 1: 500–1,000 prompts is ideal. For the dry eval Rafael will run a 100-prompt smoke test first. If you send a stratified sample (by user_flow_tag) we can ensure coverage across the three critical flows.

Next call: propose a 30-minute kickoff on Mon 2026-02-16 10:00am PT. Does that work for Priya and the engineering team?

Attachments: finlytics_prompt_samples.csv (sample stub), redwood_poc_template.xlsx (DPA stub)

Rafael will reach out once the sample is uploaded. Connor will own the infra setup (reserved instance config and model variant suggestions).

Best,
Soojin
